title: 2-1B Droid
franchise: Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith
description: 2-1B droids were marvels of medical technology, able to treat and diagnose afflictions and diseases in many species across the galaxy. A 2-1B droid oversaw the reconstruction of Darth Vader after his immolation, creating the iconic visage of his iron lung that many associated with the terror of his presence in order to keep him alive after his confrontation with his former master on Mustafar.
